Common Questions

Will adhesive shower caddies damage apartment tile when I move out?

No. Warm the clear adhesive strip with a hairdryer for 30 to 60 seconds to soften the glue, then peel it off slowly with a plastic card.

How do you store towels in a tiny bathroom with no linen closet?

Roll towels vertically on a freestanding over-the-toilet rack or use an over-the-door multi-bar towel rack to add capacity without drilling.
